name: kms
description:
Terraform module for AWS KMS CMKs. This module will:
- Create a single-region KMS key from AWS generated key material that automatically rotates every 365 days.
- Optionally create an external key instead with imported key material.
- Create a key policy with multiple permission sets including Key Owner, Key Admin, Key Users.
- Specify the alias name (while adhering with naming convention).
NOTE: The BUAdministratorAccessRole and the role executing the Terraform code will automatically be added as Key Admins.

inputs.description: Example KMS key

inputs.name: aliases
inputs.description:
A list of aliases.
  If configured, an alias for each element of the list will be built in this format: alias/{local.prefix}-{alias}-kms
  If not configured, one single alias will be built in this format: alias/{local.prefix}-{dash-separated-services-from-key_services}-kms

inputs.name: custom_key_store_id
inputs.description: ID of the KMS Custom Key Store where the key will be stored instead of KMS. This variable is ignored if `external_key` is true.

inputs.name: customer_master_key_spec
inputs.description: Specifies the type of KMS key to create. Defaults to `SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT`. For a list of valid values and help with choosing a key spec, see the [AWS KMS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/symm-asymm-choose.html). This variable is ignored if `external_key` is true.

inputs.name: deletion_window_in_days
inputs.description: The window you have to restore a disabled KMS key before it is gone forever

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: The description of the key as viewed in AWS console

inputs.name: external_key
inputs.description: Whether the created key is external

inputs.name: grants
inputs.description: A map of grant definitions to create, see type definition and [Terraform docs](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/kms_grant) for details. Note that grants will not be created if `external_key` is true and `key_material_base64` is not provided, as the key must have key material to be able to create grants

inputs.name: is_enabled
inputs.description: Specifies whether the key is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

inputs.name: key_administrators
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key administrators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-default-allow-administrators)

inputs.name: key_asymmetric_public_encryption_users
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key asymmetric public encryption users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

inputs.name: key_asymmetric_sign_verify_users
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key asymmetric sign and verify users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

inputs.name: key_hmac_users
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key HMAC users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

inputs.name: key_material_base64
inputs.description: Provide the base64 key material for key imports. This will create an external key if provided, and a regular KMS key if not. See https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/kms_external_key for more details

inputs.name: key_owners
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for those who will have full key permissions (`kms:*`)

inputs.name: key_service_users
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key service users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-service-integration)

inputs.name: key_services
inputs.description: A list of AWS services for [key users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-default-allow-users)

inputs.name: key_statements
inputs.description: A map of IAM policy [statements](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/iam_policy_document#statement) for custom permission usage

inputs.name: key_symmetric_encryption_users
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key symmetric encryption users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

inputs.name: key_usage
inputs.description: Specifies the intended use of the key. Valid values: `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT`,`SIGN_VERIFY`, or `GENERATE_VERIFY_MAC`. Defaults to `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT`

inputs.name: key_users
inputs.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-default-allow-users)

inputs.name: multi_region
inputs.description: Indicates whether the KMS key is a multi-Region (true) or regional (false) key. Defaults to `false`.

inputs.name: policy
inputs.description: A valid policy JSON document, will be merged with any configuration supplied to the key_* variables, Although this is a key policy, not an IAM policy, an `aws_iam_policy_document`, in the form that designates a principal, can be used

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: Used for naming your cloud resources. The KMS alias will be 'alias/{local.prefix}-{alias}-kms'

inputs.name: rotation_period_in_days
inputs.description: Custom period of time between each rotation date. Must be a number between 90 and 2560. This variable is ignored if `external_key` is true.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: KMS key tags. See https://experian.atlassian.net/wiki/x/swH3E for all available tags

inputs.name: xks_key_id
inputs.description: Identifies the external key that serves as key material for the KMS key in an external key store.  This variable is ignored if `external_key` is true.

outputs.name: aliases
outputs.description: A map of aliases created and their attributes

outputs.name: grants
outputs.description: A map of grants created and their attributes

outputs.name: key_arn
outputs.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key

outputs.name: key_id
outputs.description: The globally unique identifier for the key

outputs.name: key_policy
outputs.description: The IAM resource policy set on the key
